title: Share GA Reports
overview: Turn an analytics chat into a shareable report — set its visibility, choose a permission level, and share it with the right people.

steps.text: Firstly, click the Google Analytics Two-Week Summary chat to open it.
Next, click the Share chat button to export or share this conversation.
Now, click the Private option to keep this chat visible only to you.
Following that, click the “Read only” dropdown to select the appropriate sharing permission level.
Afterwards, select Read only from the dropdown to set chat access permissions.
Following that, click the “Select person…” dropdown to choose a recipient for sharing.
Following this, select a person from the dropdown to share the chat directly with them.
Following this, click the person you want to select for chat sharing.
From here, click the Share button to send this chat to specific people or teams.
To end, click the close button to dismiss the Share chat dialog.
